pages.name: GettingStarted
pages.title: Getting started
pages.summary: Put the Vimaksh look into a project: one CSS file, two fonts, one script, the wordmark. Or the tokens with Tailwind.

pages.name: Agents
pages.title: For agents
pages.summary: The Copy brand identity prompt, agents.md and every machine-readable file, with their stable URLs.

pages.name: Color
pages.title: Color
pages.summary: Paper and ink, one red for action, and a dark night for the footer. Every role has a light and a dark value; the brand colours do not change with the theme.

pages.name: Typography
pages.title: Typography
pages.summary: Inter Tight for everything that is read, set large, at weight 500 with tight negative tracking. JetBrains Mono 500, small and uppercase, for labels, navigation and buttons.

pages.name: SpacingLayout
pages.title: Spacing and layout
pages.summary: Full-width pages with one fluid gutter, generous fluid section padding, a 14px gap between cards, and two max-width breakpoints. The values below are the ones the site uses, named.

pages.name: Surfaces
pages.title: Surfaces
pages.summary: Three paper levels and one night. Surfaces are flat and square: separated by hairlines and by the paper pattern, not by shadows.

pages.name: Patterns
pages.title: Patterns and grain
pages.summary: Five textures make the brand: the paper pattern, the grain, the pixel edge, the hero's chevron field and the heat gradient. Each has one job.

pages.name: Elevation
pages.title: Elevation
pages.summary: The site is flat. There are exactly four shadows, each for one object, and two backdrop blurs. There is no elevation scale.

pages.name: Motion
pages.title: Motion
pages.summary: One easing for almost everything, short colour changes, small nudges. The hero is the only thing that always moves.

pages.name: Iconography
pages.title: Iconography
pages.summary: The site has almost no icons. Its arrow is the mono ">" chevron; the only drawn icons are the sun and moon of the theme toggle. A full icon set has not been chosen yet.

pages.name: Imagery
pages.title: Imagery
pages.summary: Real product footage in square frames, the products' own logos on paper chips, and pixel illustrations drawn on a grid. No stock photography.

pages.name: Voice
pages.title: Voice and content
pages.summary: Short declarative sentences, concrete nouns, active verbs. Curious and exacting without sounding severe. Never invent a fact: mark the gap.

pages.name: Accessibility
pages.title: Accessibility
pages.summary: Target WCAG 2.2 AA. Real DOM before scripts, a skip link, visible focus, labelled controls, live regions for errors, and motion that respects reduced motion. Two known contrast issues are listed below.

pages.name: Header
pages.title: Header
pages.summary: The wordmark at top left and the theme toggle at top right. Transparent at the top of the page; once you scroll it gets its own paper backing, hides while you read down and returns when you scroll up.

pages.name: ThemeToggle
pages.title: Theme toggle
pages.summary: A pill whose knob slides between sun and moon; the icon turns as it travels. The choice is saved in localStorage under "vimaksh-theme" and applied before first paint on every page.

pages.name: NavigationStack
pages.title: Navigation stack
pages.summary: The site's only navigation: a stack of boxed mono links fixed at the bottom right, ending in a solid Menu box. On the home hero all links show; once you scroll (and on every other page, and on phones) it folds to the Menu box, which unfolds the links again.

pages.name: Button
pages.title: Button
pages.summary: Square buttons with a mono uppercase label and a ">" chevron that nudges 5px right on hover. Primary is red; ghost has a hairline border. Both turn solid strong on hover.

pages.name: TextLink
pages.title: Text link
pages.summary: A mono link with an underline in the text colour and a red chevron that nudges 4px on hover. Used for the secondary action of a section header.

pages.name: Pill
pages.title: Pill
pages.summary: A small square mono chip that copies a value (an email, coordinates) or labels an expandable row. Hover fills it with strong. It is the site's chip; there is no separate tag component.

pages.name: CopyTooltip
pages.title: Copy tooltip
pages.summary: A tiny strong label that follows the pointer over anything with data-copy: "Copy", then "Copied ✓" (or "Copy failed") for 1.3s after a click.

pages.name: SectionHeader
pages.title: Section header
pages.summary: A top hairline, a "> Label" in mono, a large heading and an optional action on the right. It opens every content section.

pages.name: ProjectCard
pages.title: Project card
pages.summary: A product in the work grid: 4:5 video (4:3 on phones) with a number and the product's own logo on a paper chip, then title and mono kind, a one-line description, and a full-width visit bar.

pages.name: LogoChip
pages.title: Logo chip
pages.summary: A product's own logo on an off-white chip in the top-left corner of a project card. Three forms: a full logo, an icon with the name, or the name alone.

pages.name: BuildTrack
pages.title: Build card and track
pages.summary: The "What we build" row: cards with a pixel tile in the item's own colour, a numbered tag, a square bullet and a short description, on a track that drifts sideways on its own and pauses on hover, touch or focus.

pages.name: AboutBlock
pages.title: About block
pages.summary: A short statement section: a compact pixel illustration on the left and one large paragraph (t-big) on the right, centred on one line.

pages.name: Hero
pages.title: Hero
pages.summary: The home opening: a living pixel surface (WebGL) where a field of tiny ">" and "<" glyphs flows across paper and the Vimaksh mark assembles from the same pixels. Copy sits top left, a mono meta line bottom left. The page rises over it as you scroll.

pages.name: ContactBlock
pages.title: Contact block
pages.summary: Bordered card blocks made of rows: a red "Start a project" row that drops open the brief form, plain rows with copy pills, and a split block for the studio address and coordinates.

pages.name: BriefForm
pages.title: Brief form
pages.summary: The project brief: name, email, phone, company (optional) and a message. Fields are underlines with mono labels; email and phone are checked as you type and explained when you leave the field. It posts JSON to the form's action (the site uses /api/brief) and shows an honest result.

pages.name: Inputs
pages.title: Inputs and validation
pages.summary: Text fields are a single underline: --rule2 at rest, red on focus and when invalid. Errors are short mono lines under the field. The send button shows "Sending…", then "Sent" in green, or the error note in red with the email as a fallback.

pages.name: PhoneField
pages.title: Phone field
pages.summary: intl-tel-input 29.5.11, themed to the site: a flag and +code in mono with a small red chevron, a square searchable country list on --card, India preselected and a short list of common countries first. Only valid digits can be typed.

pages.name: Footer
pages.title: Footer
pages.summary: Always dark (night) in both themes. A pixel edge breaks its top, the mark flies in, a large statement sits beside the brief card, four columns of facts follow, and a heat-gradient base carries the giant white wordmark.

pages.name: PixelEdge
pages.title: Pixel edge
pages.summary: A band of squares, 7 rows of 14px cells (10px on phones), that thins toward the far edge. It joins one area to the next instead of a straight line: the hero to the work section, the page to the footer.

pages.name: LegalPage
pages.title: Legal page
pages.summary: A single readable column (max 760px) for terms, privacy and cookies: a mono label, a t-hero title at a smaller size, the update date in mono, and 16px/1.6 body with 22px section headings.

pages.name: SkipLink
pages.title: Skip link
pages.summary: The first element on every page: "Skip to content", off screen until it receives focus, then a strong box at top left.

pages.name: Brand
pages.title: Brand
pages.summary: The six-arrow mark (five coral, one red), the Vimaksh wordmark, and the 3D logo sculpture. Use the files as they are, in the colours the site uses them in.

pages.name: PixelMotifs
pages.title: Pixel motifs
pages.summary: The pixel graphics of the site, drawn by its own code: one tile per kind of software, the studio desk, pixel edges and the hero's chevron glyphs. PNG, SVG, or draw them live.

pages.name: Icons
pages.title: Icons
pages.summary: Every icon the site uses, ready to copy. The full icon set is still to come.

pages.name: Downloads
pages.title: Downloads
pages.summary: Logos, pixel motifs, fonts and the 3D logo, as single files or ZIP packs, each with a SHA-256 hash.
